scope: Tested-source binding for the preimplementation audit. Generic review text describes coordinate-layer ownership; concrete implemented reset/render policies are in README and contract. Not every item subtype has separate runtime coverage.

Direct zoom-on-resize writes reset residual; normal resize/clamp updates transform.
Canvas draw applies common matrix; verify actual cairo CTM/raster.
Image-origin changes call explicit scroll_set_offset; residual deliberately reset there as for any native integer reposition.
Item damage converts every region rectangle through rotate_bounds when matrix exists. Read only: owned by another task.
Raster drawing applies common matrix; fractional changes must invalidate/expose full cache, not translate existing integer cache.
Append device translation after ordinary rotate matrix; always create matrix for nonzero residual, even angle0. Existing center save/restore passes through inverse.
Uses rotated image bounds and rotated scale; fractional bounds need independent ruler/landmark check.
Explicit scale_by_values resets fractional origin after deriving focus; same integer values must not bypass reset. dot-for-dot/resolution update must clear or rescale consistently.

Integer pan preserves residual as a constant translation; inherited fractional pan bypasses rotated modern clamp for exact old axis clamp. Explicit set-offset resets residual even at equal integer offsets. Native clamp clears clipped residual axis. Empty image clears both.
Integer adjustment interface stays integer; exact fractional view is represented by matrix. Track boundary steppers separately for legacy clamp.
Selection drawing and bounds apply common matrix, including zero-angle residual matrix; verify selection raster.
Percent offset title is display metadata, not coordinate transform; include residual when reporting view position.

All full forward/inverse coordinate and bounds APIs already apply rotate_transform/untransform; zoom/unzoom-only APIs intentionally operate before this matrix. Residual belongs in shared matrix, not duplicated in raw offset math.
Upright GTK overlay anchors use full transforms. Empty/fill lifecycle must clear residual; append state without changing existing integer types.

implemented_policies.shared_matrix: Fraction appended in rotate_update_transform including zero angle; common inverse generated from same matrix
implemented_policies.render_damage: Inherited fractional motion fully invalidates raster cache and emits scrolled for upright anchors. Native integer incremental scroll fully invalidates if clipping changes fraction. Image-space items and selection share outer matrix; no duplicate fraction in pre-matrix zoom helpers.
implemented_policies.reset: Explicit set-offset (including same integer value), scale-by-values, scale grid change, zoom-on-resize, empty shell clear fraction. Pan release clears anchors only.
implemented_policies.native_integer_ui: Scrollbar values remain native integer offsets. Rulers consume existing integer-rounded rotated bounds. Title offset formatter includes effective fraction. Not exact old scrollbar/ruler widget parity.
implemented_policies.input: Finite raw, unrotated and image-coordinate ranges checked before native processing. Pan begin checks Cairo inversion and finite transformed press/origin before narrowing.
implemented_policies.runtime_coverage: 1920 motions /5760 point and inverse pairs; bounded actual raster ROI/item CTM/upright GTK anchor tests, native transition/custom/space/input cases. Not every canvas item subtype independently rendered.
